source_evidence: Many firms are registered as both a broker and an adviser and offer both advisory and brokerage services and accounts.  They are called dual registrants.
answer: A dual registrant is a firm registered as both a broker and an investment adviser. It may offer both brokerage and advisory services and accounts. Because the services offered and how you pay can differ, check your relationship summary and make sure you understand when your financial professional is acting as a broker and when they are acting as an adviser.
